verdict.rationale: The API reference URLs show a versioned path scheme (v-1-alpha-1) across endpoints such as capitalization table, stakeholders, option grants and draft option grants, so the API is versioned. That version is labeled alpha, and nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or version-lifecycle guarantees. Missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, stable (non-alpha) version guarantees, versioning/changelog documentation, independent corroboration.
